The '''N4-SW Runner''' was a type of small [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The N4-SW Runner appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a pet. It was a reward for players of the game ''Need for Speed World'' as part of the cross-promotion between [[Electronic Arts]]'s free-to-play games; players of ''Need for Speed World'' who created an account in ''The Old Republic'' by [[April 1]], [[2013]] received the pet.
